main_text.p: dit sine incendio, infernus contrà sine luce incendium; dignus mehercle illis, qui spretâ veritati luce, flammis contentionum refocillari gestiunt. Oderunt verò pacem planissime,qui erroribus fidei Christianæ infestissimis, præfracto animo patrocinantur: Quamdiu habitandum nobis erit propter tentoria hæc Kedarena, queremur merito quod olim Psaltes, Ego pacem diligo,ipsi interim ad bellum conclamant: Neque nos ingenui pacis cultores (quando ita nobis incumbit pugnæ necessitas) nihil agimus: Enimuero sanctus ille chorus AnPsal. 120.-

page.notes: Marginal reference at left reads "Psal. 120." (printed as "Psal.ııo."). Left margin also has a small bullet mark. Bottom word "ge-" is a catchword at the right. Ink show-through from the reverse side is ignored. Text "Psaltes" retains printed long s form as shown; the hyphenated line ends "An-" continue on the next page.
